title: The Curse of Conditions: Analyzing and Improving Optimal Transport for Conditional Flow-Based Generation
tldr_zh: 无条件 minibatch OT 在条件生成中系统性有害（训练先验被条件偏斜），成本矩阵加条件项即修复。
tldr_en: Minibatch OT coupling skews the training prior conditionally and hurts conditional FM; C2OT adds a condition-aware cost term to restore x0-c independence.
